36. func (a *AllocatorAlibabaCloud) Init(ctx context.Context) error {
37. 	var aMetrics openapi.MetricsAPI
38. 
39. 	if operatorOption.Config.EnableMetrics {
40. 		aMetrics = apiMetrics.NewPrometheusMetrics(operatorMetrics.Namespace, "alibabacloud", operatorMetrics.Registry)
41. 	} else {
42. 		aMetrics = &apiMetrics.NoOpMetrics{}
43. 	}
44. 
45. 	var err error
46. 	vpcID := operatorOption.Config.AlibabaCloudVPCID
47. 	if vpcID == "" {
48. 		vpcID, err = metadata.GetVPCID(ctx)
49. 		if err != nil {
50. 			return err
51. 		}
52. 	}
53. 	regionID, err := metadata.GetRegionID(ctx)
54. 	if err != nil {
55. 		return err
56. 	}
57. 
58. 	vpcClient, err := vpc.NewClientWithProvider(regionID)
59. 	if err != nil {
60. 		return err
61. 	}
62. 	ecsClient, err := ecs.NewClientWithProvider(regionID)
63. 	if err != nil {
64. 		return err
65. 	}
66. 	// Send API requests to "vpc" network endpoints instead of the default "public" network
67. 	// endpoints, so the ECS instance hosting cilium-operator doesn't require public network access
68. 	// to reach alibabacloud API.
69. 	// vpc endpoints are spliced to the format: <product>-<network>.<region_id>.aliyuncs.com
70. 	// e.g. ecs-vpc.cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com
71. 	// ref https://github.com/aliyun/alibaba-cloud-sdk-go/blob/master/docs/11-Endpoint-EN.md
72. 	vpcClient.Network = "vpc"
73. 	ecsClient.Network = "vpc"
74. 
75. 	vpcClient.GetConfig().WithScheme("HTTPS")
76. 	ecsClient.GetConfig().WithScheme("HTTPS")
77. 
78. 	a.client = openapi.NewClient(vpcClient, ecsClient, aMetrics, operatorOption.Config.IPAMAPIQPSLimit,
79. 		operatorOption.Config.IPAMAPIBurst, map[string]string{openapi.VPCID: vpcID})
80. 
81. 	if err := limits.UpdateFromAPI(ctx, a.client); err != nil {
82. 		return fmt.Errorf("unable to update instance type to adapter limits from AlibabaCloud API: %w", err)
83. 	}
84. 
85. 	return nil
86. }

89. // APIs is done in a blocking manner. Provided this is successful, a controller is
90. // started to manage allocation based on CiliumNode custom resources
91. func (a *AllocatorAlibabaCloud) Start(ctx context.Context, getterUpdater ipam.CiliumNodeGetterUpdater) (allocator.NodeEventHandler, error) {
92. 	var iMetrics ipam.MetricsAPI
93. 
94. 	log.Info("Starting AlibabaCloud ENI allocator...")
95. 
96. 	if operatorOption.Config.EnableMetrics {
97. 		iMetrics = ipamMetrics.NewPrometheusMetrics(operatorMetrics.Namespace, operatorMetrics.Registry)
98. 	} else {
99. 		iMetrics = &ipamMetrics.NoOpMetrics{}
100. 	}
101. 	instances := eni.NewInstancesManager(a.client)
102. 	nodeManager, err := ipam.NewNodeManager(instances, getterUpdater, iMetrics,
103. 		operatorOption.Config.ParallelAllocWorkers, operatorOption.Config.AlibabaCloudReleaseExcessIPs, false)
104. 	if err != nil {
105. 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unable to initialize AlibabaCloud node manager: %w", err)
106. 	}
107. 
108. 	if err := nodeManager.Start(ctx); err != nil {
109. 		return nil, err
110. 	}
111. 
112. 	return nodeManager, nil
113. }

Alibaba-focused packages pass with the upgraded module. A broader `./pkg/...` run hit an unrelated timing-sensitive failure in `pkg/api/helpers` rate limiting.
